objective: Stop a Dependabot action bump from turning the release workflow tests red, by resolving the pinned action sha from the workflow instead of repeating it in the test.
decision_supported: Is a hardcoded action sha part of the contract these tests defend, or an implementation detail that should be read from the workflow?
acceptance: No test hardcodes an actions/upload-artifact sha.
The test still asserts the step uses that action, by reading the pin from the workflow.
A full commit sha is required: a tag reference fails with a message naming the action.
Changing the pinned sha in the workflow does not fail the test.
evidence: Two assertions in tests/unit/test_release_workflow.py repeated the v7.0.1 sha, so the Dependabot bump to v7.0.2 in #395 failed them while the workflow was correct.
Rewriting every upload-artifact pin in ci.yml to the v7.0.2 sha leaves the suite green.
Replacing the pin with the tag v7.0.1 fails both assertions with 'is not pinned to a full commit sha'.
stop_conditions: The workflow stops pinning the action to a sha; that is a contract violation and the helper asserts it.
risks_and_fallbacks: Reading the pin means a workflow that pins the wrong sha is not caught; pin correctness belongs to Dependabot and the review, not to this test.
The helper asserts a 40-character hex string, so an unpinned or tag reference still fails.
